nominal_bit_time_structure.SYNC_SEG: 1 Time Quantum (tq). Used to synchronize the various nodes; an edge is expected to lie within this segment.
nominal_bit_time_structure.PROP_SEG: Lumped into NTSEG1 with PHASE_SEG1 in M_CAN's encoding. Compensates for physical delay times on the network: twice the sum of (signal propagation + input comparator delay + output driver delay).
nominal_bit_time_structure.NBRP: Programmable 1..512 (NBRP[8:0]+1). Bit Rate Prescaler in arbitration phase. tq = NBRP × m_can_cclk period.
nominal_bit_time_structure.SAMPLE_POINT: At the end of NTSEG1 — bus level read.
nominal_bit_time_structure.INFORMATION_PROCESSING_TIME: 0 tq (data for next bit available at first clock edge after sample point — M_CAN-specific zero IPT).

synchronization_waveform.HARD_SYNCHRONIZATION: Restarts internal bit time with SYNC_SEG; forced by recessive-to-dominant edge during BUS IDLE.
synchronization_waveform.RESYNCHRONIZATION_arbitration: Lengthens NTSEG1 (positive phase error ≤ NSJW) or shortens NTSEG2 (negative phase error ≤ NSJW).
synchronization_waveform.RESYNCHRONIZATION_data: Lengthens DTSEG1 (positive phase error ≤ DSJW) or shortens DTSEG2 (negative phase error ≤ DSJW).
synchronization_waveform.EFBI_filter: CCCR.EFBI = 1: 2 consecutive dominant tq required for hard sync.

frame_waveform.CLASSICAL_DATA_FRAME: SOF (1d) → ARBITRATION → CONTROL (r1 r0 DLC) → DATA (0..64 bits) → CRC15 + recessive delim → ACK → EOF → INTERMISSION
frame_waveform.CLASSICAL_REMOTE_FRAME: Same as CLASSICAL_DATA_FRAME but RTR = recessive and no DATA FIELD.
frame_waveform.CAN_FD_DATA_FRAME_no_BRS: SOF → ARBITRATION (RRS dominant) → CONTROL (r1 + FDF=1 + res=0 + BRS=0 + ESI + DLC) → DATA (0..512 bits) → [ISO: STUFF_COUNT + parity] → CRC17/CRC21 + delim → ACK → EOF → INTERMISSION. All at NBTP rate.
frame_waveform.CAN_FD_DATA_FRAME_with_BRS: Same but BRS = recessive. From BRS bit through CRC sequence at DBTP rate; CRC delimiter back to NBTP.
frame_waveform.ERROR_FRAME: ACTIVE/PASSIVE ERROR FLAG (6 dominant/recessive bits) → ERROR DELIMITER (8 recessive bits)
frame_waveform.OVERLOAD_FRAME: OVERLOAD FLAG (6 dominant bits) → OVERLOAD DELIMITER (8 recessive bits)

interframe_space_waveform.INTERMISSION: 3 recessive bits; no station may start a transmission during this time.
interframe_space_waveform.SUSPEND_TRANSMISSION: 8 recessive bits after INTERMISSION; only for error-passive transmitters.
interframe_space_waveform.TRANSMIT_PAUSE: 2 additional CAN bit times when CCCR.TXP = 1.

active_error_flag_superposition_waveform: When multiple nodes detect the error and each transmit a 6-dominant-bit ACTIVE ERROR FLAG, the result on the bus is a superposition of 6..12 dominant bits depending on detection timing.

phase_error_definition.e_gt_0: Edge lies before the SAMPLE POINT.
phase_error_definition.e_lt_0: Edge lies after the SAMPLE POINT of the previous bit.

data_bit_time_structure.DTSEG1: Programmable 2..32 tq (DTSEG1[4:0]+1). Combined Prop_Seg + Phase_Seg1 in data phase.
data_bit_time_structure.DTSEG2: Programmable 2..16 tq (DTSEG2[3:0]+1). Phase_Seg2 in data phase. Range harmonized with ISO 11898-1:2015 in M_CAN v3.2.1.1 (errata #16).
data_bit_time_structure.DBRP: Programmable 1..32 (DBRP[4:0]+1). Data Bit Rate Prescaler; limited to 1..2 when TDC is enabled.

transmitter_delay_compensation_waveform.principle: During CAN FD data phase the transmitter compares received bit against transmitted bit at the Secondary Sample Point (SSP).
transmitter_delay_compensation_waveform.measurement_window_start: Falling edge of FDF → res transition on m_can_tx.
transmitter_delay_compensation_waveform.constraint_sum_le_6_bit_times: sum of measured delay + TDCO ≤ 6 bit times in data phase.

reset_bit_timing_examples.NBTP_reset_8MHz_500kbps: NBRP=1, NTSEG1=12, NTSEG2=4, NSJW=4 → 16 tq → 500 kbps at 8 MHz m_can_cclk.
reset_bit_timing_examples.DBTP_reset_8MHz_500kbps: DBRP=1, DTSEG1=12, DTSEG2=4, DSJW=4 → 16 tq → 500 kbps at 8 MHz m_can_cclk.
reset_bit_timing_examples.CAN_FD_5Mbps_example: 20 MHz m_can_cclk + DBRP=1 + 4 tq bit time → 5 Mbit/s data phase.

byte_packing_in_message_ram.note: Element size words = data_bytes / 4 + 2 header words (rounded up per RXESC / TXESC encoding).

standard_id_filter_path: If remote frame AND GFC.RRFS = 1 → discard.
Else: walk SIDFC.LSS standard filter elements.
First matching element → apply SFEC action.
No match: ANFS[1]=0 → accept to FIFO0/FIFO1 per ANFS[0]; ANFS[1]=1 → discard.
If target FIFO selected and full in blocking mode → discard.
extended_id_filter_path: Valid 29-bit identifier path: ID ANDed with XIDAM before filter list comparison.
If remote frame AND GFC.RRFE = 1 → discard.
Else: walk XIDFC.LSE extended filter elements.
No match: ANFE[1]=0 → accept; ANFE[1]=1 → discard.
